232-678-997.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2577-4247-4871.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional Zombie.
You control another Zombie.
2577-4247-4871.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

413-824-2728-4153.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
413-824-2728-4153.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
413-824-2728-4153.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage.
Repeat from step 4.

3809-4682-7890.notablePrerequisites: At least two opponents cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
3809-4682-7890.description:
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing two opponents to each draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}{W} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Repeat.

1263-4871-5147-6887.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3000-3297-7304.manaNeeded: {U} and {G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable
3000-3297-7304.description:
Cast Genghis Frog either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Artificial Evolution by paying its mana cost, changing all instances of "Mutant" on Genghis Frog to "Squirrel".
Resolve the Genghis Frog ability, creating a Mutagen token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token due to Chatterfang.
When the Squirrel enters, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token due to Chatterfang.
Repeat step 5.
3000-3297-7304.notes: Step 5 creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

339-677-4050-4460.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7229.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ambitious Dragonborn.
When Ambitious Dragonborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

4871-5220-5256-5651.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-5256-5651.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2872-5921-5970-6968.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

277-2034-3875-7090.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ba Sing Se, adding {C}{C}.
When Ba Sing Se dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Ba Sing Se enters, Tireless Provisioner and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Ba Sing Se.
Repeat.

2034-2173-5220-6537.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

193-3604-4045.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ur-Golem's Eye by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Ur-Golem's Eye.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-3604-4045.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

2034-2732-6132.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

513-527-4927.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
513-527-4927.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1987-2468-2751-4131.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Basalt Monolith and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

710-1703-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Fool's Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1527-2557-4911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls an indestructible creature, or you have a way to give an opponent's creature indestructible.
You control a number of artifacts greater than two times the indestructible creature's toughness.
1527-2557-4911.description:
Give an opponent's creature indestructible, if needed.
Activate Ghirapur Aether Grid by tapping two artifacts you control, dealing 1 damage to an indestructible creature an opponent controls.
If the creature has less than 0 toughness, Magmatic Galleon's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

579-1185-1818-1942-2308.notablePrerequisites:
Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
579-1185-1818-1942-2308.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Healer of the Pride triggers, holding priority, activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {2}.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 3 life due to Bilbo.
Prize Pig and Trudge Garden trigger.
Resolve the Prize Pig trigger, putting three ribbon counters of Prize Pig, then removing all ribbon counters from Prize Pig and untapping it.
Resolve the Trudge Garden trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Bilbo's ability if it doesn't have summoning sickness to put all creature cards from your library onto the battlefield.

1067-1422-1785-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Soldevi Adnate.
1067-1422-1785-2178.description:
Activate Rimefeather Owl by paying {1}{U}, putting an ice counter on Soldevi Adnate and causing it to become snow.
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Narfi, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
When Narfi dies, Soldevi Adnate triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Narfi by paying {S}{S}{S}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-4478-4689.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-4689.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1902-1909-4499-4977.notablePrerequisites:
Wirewood Channeler does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five Elves.
1902-1909-4499-4977.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning Fyndhorn Elves from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Wirewood Symbiote.
Cast Fyndhorn Elves by paying {G}.
Repeat.
